methodology.limitation: ExpiredDomains.net and DomCop require login to view individual domain listings; Google does not index their per-domain pages. Absence from search results does NOT mean absence from their databases — it means no PUBLIC discussion or indexing.

godaddy_clawback_risk.description: Active lawsuit (Crisby Studio AB / Prime Loyalty LLC vs GoDaddy) over auction clawbacks of calor.com and butane.com. GoDaddy clawed back domains ~2 months after auction sale, claiming they were 'auctioned in error'. Court in March 2026 allowed discovery into other clawback instances. All 6 of our GoDaddy-registered domains (olive.com, infarm.com, veev.com, ghostautonomy.com, fiskerinc.com, northvolt.com) face this risk if the original registrant or bankruptcy trustee objects during or after the auction.
godaddy_clawback_risk.mitigation: Do not invest heavily in development/marketing until 90+ days post-acquisition. Budget for potential clawback loss.

domains.assessment: Competition level rated HIGH despite no current public discussion. Rationale: one-word .com domains are the MOST monitored category in domain investing. Every serious domain investor runs automated alerts for single-word .com drops. When olive.com enters GoDaddy's expired auction, expect 50-200+ bidders. The $902M Olive AI shutdown was widely covered by Healthcare Dive, Axios, TechCrunch — domain pros track startup death lists. This domain will NOT fly under any radar.
domains.strategy: Set maximum bid. Accept that competition will be fierce. One-word .com is worth $10K+ in any scenario.

domains.assessment: LOW competition — our BEST information advantage domain. Rationale: 'ghostautonomy.com' is a 2-word branded domain, not a generic or dictionary term. Domain investors primarily hunt single-word .coms, 4L.coms, and keyword-rich names. A branded compound like 'ghostautonomy' has no SEO keyword value and no obvious resale market. The only buyers would be: (1) someone wanting to rebuild in the autonomous driving space with this specific brand, or (2) backlink-focused SEO buyers targeting the 547 RD. The Jun 7 expiry is imminent. Competition assessment: likely 0-3 other backorders.
domains.strategy: PRIORITY CATCH. Low competition + high backlink value (547 RD from $220M funded company) = best ROI opportunity. Place backorders on DropCatch + SnapNames + NameJet immediately.

domains.assessment: MEDIUM-HIGH competition but ACQUISITION RISK. Lyten purchased Northvolt's remaining assets including 'all of its IP' in August 2025. Domain names are typically considered IP assets. There is a significant probability that northvolt.com transferred to Lyten as part of the acquisition and will NOT drop. If it does somehow drop, the Northvolt brand recognition ($13B raised) means heavy competition from brand speculators, battery/EV industry buyers, and domain investors.

domains.strategy: DEPRIORITIZE. High probability domain was included in Lyten's asset acquisition. Monitor WHOIS for registrant changes but do not place backorders yet.
domains.risk: Domain likely transferred to Lyten with other IP assets. Even if it drops, massive global brand recognition = fierce competition.
